import os
base='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for q in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    a,b=q
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and q not in seen and grid[a][b]==v:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            objs.append((v,cells))
    # Pack each object as far right as possible, placing rightmost objects first.
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:max(c for r,c in o[1]), reverse=True)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for v,cells in objs:
        shift=0
        while True:
            ns=shift+1
            if any(c+ns>=w or out[r][c+ns]!=0 for r,c in cells): break
            shift=ns
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+shift]=v
    return out
'''
open(base+'/task-1ca134b5.py','w').write(code)
exec(code)
